scientific_role: Train a supervised pre-item-retrieval source router under explicitly noisy, judge-conditioned weak supervision; do not estimate human-optimal actions.

judge_aggregation.estimand: per-dimension median across the two frozen development judge families

training_objective.risk_heads: separate weak risk-dimension heads with action-applicability zero weights
training_objective.cost: deterministic observed token and retrieval-call inputs; never judged

known_limitations: Both original absolute-label instruments failed their preregistered automatic-gold qualification gates.
Judge-family disagreement, saturation and low directional transfer are retained as measurement noise, not tuned away.
Seven ESConv auxiliary response judgments were recovered offline only after removing a non-scientific rationale character cap; their recovery lineage remains explicit.
The labels support judge-conditioned learnability claims only, not human-optimal routing or real-world clinical benefit.
